goal_intent: book for two with a severe peanut allergy and ask how the kitchen handles allergens

turns.utterance: Hi there, I'm calling because I'm planning a little dinner out and wanted to check on your availability for a booking.
It'll just be the two of us—I thought a Friday evening would be perfect. I also wanted to ask about food allergies, since one of us has a severe peanut allergy.
7pm would be great, if you have a slot. And could you tell me a bit about how your kitchen handles allergens and avoids cross-contamination? It's really important to us.

Yes, please go ahead and book us in for 2 people at 7pm this Friday under the name Sam Ellery. And if you could make a note about the severe peanut allergy, I'd really appreciate it while you check with your team.
That’s perfect, thank you for double-checking! I’ll wait to hear back about your kitchen’s allergy procedure as well, since it really puts my mind at ease.
